Costco's average quarterly net cash provided by operating activities in fiscal 2026 was about $3.95 billion.

Costco's 10-K for the year ended August 30, 2026, reports net cash provided by operating activities of $15,817 million in 2026, compared with $13,335 million in 2025. The fiscal fourth-quarter earnings release showed a slightly different figure of $15,825 million. I used the 10-K number because it is the filed figure.

Dividing by four quarters gives $15,817 million ÷ 4 ≈ $3,954 million per quarter.

The quarters aren't equal, because Costco's first quarter is 12 weeks and its fourth is 12 weeks, while the other quarters are also 12 weeks except the 16-week first quarter. Treat the figure as a simple average.
